basis: Every authored documentation source selected for CC-001 is MyST Markdown; the repository has no authored RST source file.
The sole embedded RST use is the reference page's eval-rst fence around directives that MyST supports natively.
The operator selected Option 1: authored documentation is MyST-only, RST sources and eval-rst are refused, and document structure is interpreted by the pinned MyST parser.
limitations: The decision governs the CC-001 authored documentation corpus, not every input format Sphinx can process.
Excluded research Markdown remains outside the selected public-documentation consumer, while the repository-wide RST refusal still applies.
Regular expressions may support test fixtures or diagnostic assertions but may not parse document structure or enforce semantic policy.

summary: Select MyST-only authored documentation for CC-001.
why: Supporting an unused RST source grammar required private Docutils state machinery and process-isolation controls. Refusing that grammar removes the accidental mechanism while preserving every selected public page through native MyST directives.
